page.overview:
Who is Peter Lauritson?

Peter Lauritson was a male individual who lived during the 24th century.

In 2328, the ferried him from Beta Berman I to K Fernandes Colony. His passenger manifest was accessed by Lieutenant Commander Data aboard the in 2370 by reviewing this data in the commercial transport database. (, okudagram)

In 2365, Lauritson, a Starfleet captain, was listed as the commander of the on the Starship Deploy Status chart in the Starbase 173 courtroom. ( okudagram)

In 2368, he resided in Alpha Municipality on Epsilon Nel III. On stardate 45221.8, he was treated at the Goodhartz Medical Facility (Grant Municipality) for a coma of unknown cause. It was later discovered that Lauritson had been the victim of a telepathic memory invasion by the Ullian Jev. (, okudagram)
